name: SAR9 T SC GEN3 Black
lead: The SAR9 T SC Gen3, one of Sarsılmaz's new generation models, offers an highly comfortable use with its fingersupported magazine and polymer frame that provides maximum grip comfort.
description: The SAR9 T SC Gen3, one of Sarsılmaz's new generation models, offers an highly comfortable use with its fingersupported magazine and polymer frame that provides maximum grip comfort.

Offering advanced advantages despite its compact design, the SAR9T SC Gen3 has a picatinny rail design that perfectly fits accessories such as flashlights and laser pointers. The SAR9T SC Gen3 prioritizes user safety with a square trigger guard that facilitates accessory mounting while increasing grip comfort, as well as a safe flat trigger design that seamlessly combines precision and performance. The SAR9T SC Gen3's slide design, which is suitable for optical mounting and has innovative lines that facilitate slide manipulation, maximizes RMSc red-dot compatibility, a soughtafter feature of the subcompact segment. The SAR9T SC Gen3 can be used with mechanical sights with its
co-witnessed front sight system and customizable dovetail front sight mount. The SAR9T SC Gen3 also stands out with its barrel design that allows suppressor/silencer integration.
